subject: An office that closes away
hook: A small hole that lets you shut the doors mid-charge
ig:
A small hole that lets you shut the office doors while everything is still charging.

It is a cable grommet: a lined opening in the desktop that drops leads straight down into the cupboard below.

Why it matters in an office that closes away:
No cables over the front edge, so nothing gets trapped when the doors shut.
Chargers live inside, out of sight, plugged into a socket in the cupboard.
Your laptop can be charging overnight with the room looking like a living room again.

The position is worth planning at the design stage. Put it where your laptop actually sits, usually a back corner, not dead centre.

Which detail would make the biggest difference to your desk? Comment and tell us.
